Analytics Table Description:
The AllApplications table contains all (building, layout permission, etc) applications in the BuildNow system, regardless of their current status. This includes draft applications still being prepared by citizens or architects, applications under various stages of review by government authorities (DTCP, GHMC, HMDA), failed applications requiring corrections, and completed applications (approved/rejected)...

This table stores both submitted and non-submitted applications. Submitted applications are separately maintained in the SubmittedApplications table. To identify draft or non-submitted applications, exclude records that exist in the SubmittedApplications table.

It includes applications that are submitted to department. In general context analysis will be done on submitted applications only unless asked to include draft applications also in specific. 
Majority of the analysis will be done on submitted applications only

The ApplicationOfficers table tracks individual officer assignments and processing activities for each submitted application. This table maintains a detailed log of which officers are assigned to specific applications, their processing timelines, and SLA compliance. Each record represents a single officer's involvement in an application's review process, capturing both assignment and completion timestamps.

The ApplicationOfficersHierarchy table establishes the complete officer hierarchy structure for each submitted application. Unlike ApplicationOfficers which tracks individual assignments sequentially, this table provides a comprehensive view of all officers assigned across all levels (L1-L4) and specialized roles for a specific application.

This table serves as the master assignment matrix, showing the complete organizational structure responsible for processing each application.

The Officers table maintains the master registry of all government officers involved in the TG-bPASS application processing workflow. This includes officers from various departments and authorities (DTCP, GHMC, HMDA) as well as line department officers (Revenue, Irrigation, Fire, Title verification) who participate in the multi-level verification process.

The ApplicationLineDepartmentDetails table tracks the review process by specialized line departments for submitted applications. Certain applications require additional approvals from specific government departments beyond the primary processing authority (DTCP/GHMC/HMDA). This table maintains records of officer assignments, processing timelines, and completion status for these departmental reviews.
